purpose: A LINEAR PROBE DIAGNOSTIC that asks whether a feature group carries cross-view predictive information about the per-view bias. It is NOT a proposed calibration method.
model: Ridge regression (scikit-learn), fitted on the training fold only
target: signed log focal bias of AnyCalib-gen radial:2 per view
preprocessing: no statistic of any kind is taken from the held-out fold
alpha_selection: inner K-fold cross-validation INSIDE the training fold only; the held-out fold is never consulted
inner_cv: GroupKFold by physical camera within the training fold, k = min(5, number of training cameras)

diagnostic_only_feature_sets.D_CAMERA_ID: one-hot physical camera - ORACLE_OR_RIG_SPECIFIC_DIAGNOSTIC, a ceiling-like reference, never deployable

outer_validation.A_LOSO: leave one sequence out (5 folds). A CONTENT/SEQUENCE SHIFT test: the same physical camera may appear in train and test, so it is NOT a new-camera test.
outer_validation.B_LOCO: leave one physical camera out (40 folds). The NEW CAMERA test, and the primary decision criterion.

metrics: MAE of the predicted log bias
LINEAR_PROBE_CORRECTION_DIAGNOSTIC: f_corrected = f_pred / exp(b_hat), then median relative focal error, within +/-5 %, within +/-10 %, signed median

tags.DEPLOYABLE_RGB_SIGNAL_PROMISING: A or B met on LOCO and the direction holds
tags.WEAK_RGB_SIGNAL: improvement present but below both thresholds
